# Pixel Tip Calculator

A responsive, offline tip calculator with a pixel-art inspired theme. Enter a bill amount, choose a tip percentage (10%, 15%, or 20%), and specify the number of people to split the total. The app displays the tip amount and the total per person.

## Features

- Bill amount input with decimal support
- Tip percentage buttons (10%, 15%, 20%) with active state
- Number of people input for splitting the total
- Live calculation of tip and total per person
- Keyboard accessible: all controls are focusable and operable via keyboard
- Responsive layout down to 360px width
- Pixel-art aesthetic using CSS only (no external assets)

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern web browser. No server or build step required.

## File Structure

- `index.html` – main HTML structure
- `styles.css` – styling and pixel-art theme
- `script.js` – calculation logic and interactivity
- `README.md` – this file

## Notes

- All calculations are rounded to two decimal places for display.
- The app works completely offline and makes no network requests.
- No external libraries or frameworks are used.
